create_DatasetMetaData: create a DatasetMetaData instance with name, version, and sample counts for a compression dataset
create_ParamMetaData: create a ParamMetaData instance with name, shape, and weight hash for a model parameter
create_LayerMetaData: create a LayerMetaData instance with name, type, input/output shapes, and parameters
create_ModelMetaData: create a ModelMetaData instance with architecture, input/output shapes, and nested layers
build_recipe_metadata: build a complete ModelMetaData hierarchy with DatasetMetaData, LayerMetaData, and ParamMetaData for an LLM compression recipe
